note: The conformance rule catalogue. Each rule is a version-controlled, documented conformance check bound to a registered gate in scripts/conformance_result.py. Rules must not exist solely as undocumented conditions inside scripts (REQ-23-01).

severity.error: A mandatory conformance requirement has failed.
severity.warning: A quality concern or potential inconsistency requires review.
severity.deferred: A requirement or assessment is formally deferred.

severity_default_handling.error: Blocks acceptance unless an explicitly permitted exception applies.
severity_default_handling.warning: Requires disposition according to the applicable policy.
severity_default_handling.deferred: Requires approved disposition and accountable ownership.

progressive_enforcement.baseline_defect_policy: A historical baseline defect does not block acceptance. A newly introduced defect blocks acceptance immediately. A baseline defect carries an accountable remediation owner and a review date; it is never silently grandfathered.
progressive_enforcement.exception_policy: An exception is scoped, owned, approved, reviewable, revocable and time-bound. It does not alter the underlying rule and does not propagate to child entities.
progressive_enforcement.new_defect_policy: A defect introduced by the change under assessment blocks acceptance. The baseline is the recorded finding count of the pre-change tree.
